h3: Fresh, Clean & Hassle-Free Laundry Awaits You! Book Your Pickup Now!
paragraphs: A Decade of Clean, Care & Convenience – Trusted by Thousands Across Mumbai

At Mr. and Mrs. Laundry, laundry isn’t just a chore — it’s a commitment to cleanliness, care, and convenience. Founded in 2012, we’ve grown into one of Mumbai’s most trusted laundry service providers, proudly serving over 5,000+ loyal customers across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, and Thane.

With over a decade of experience, we’ve refined the art of laundry and dry cleaning, offering everything from wash & fold, express laundry, premium garment care, and shoe cleaning, to curtain and carpet cleaning. Whether it’s your daily wear or your delicate designer pieces, our expert team handles every item with precision, using modern equipment and eco-friendly solutions to ensure the highest quality standards.

Our state-of-the-art facility in Malad East is equipped to process everything efficiently - ensuring garments are cleaned, treated, ironed, and packed with perfection. With free doorstep pickup and delivery, 24/7 availability, online payment options, and a strong emphasis on hygiene and customer satisfaction, we make laundry completely hassle-free.
To become the most trusted and innovative laundry service brand in India - redefining convenience, quality, and customer care in every household we serve.
To deliver reliable, affordable, and high-quality laundry solutions with unmatched customer service - because your time and clothes deserve the best.
